sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of the listeners, a quiet people in pale robes who tend a garden of giant half-sunk spheres and listen to them hum. Three pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a small rounded cap of pale cream cloth that leaves the ears bare, with a single dot of ochre at the crown; a thin ringed band of brass round the brow, like the rings round the spheres; an elder's soft hood falling to the shoulders, open round the ears. Every piece sits close on the head, nothing floating above it, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream, pale yellow and sage, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
